Deterministic Markdown vault graph tools

USAGE
    norn [OPTIONS] <COMMAND>

COMMANDS
    find              Find documents in the vault — full-text + metadata filters with sort/limit/paging
    count             Count documents in the vault — grouped or total — with the find filter surface
    describe          Describe the vault: structure counts, the declared config with --schema, a contents-summary with --data
    get               Get one or more documents — frontmatter, headings, outgoing/incoming/unresolved links
    set               Update one document — schema-aware frontmatter mutation + wholesale body replacement
    edit              Edit one document's body — atomic content-anchored partial edits
    new               Create a new document — schema-aware frontmatter pre-fill from path rules
    init              Scaffold .norn/config.yaml
    move              Move/rename a document with cascading backlink rewrites
    delete            Delete a document, optionally redirecting incoming links to an alternate target
    apply             Apply a MigrationPlan — execute move, delete, rewrite, and frontmatter ops from a plan file
    repair            Surface deterministic-repair findings; --plan emits a MigrationPlan
    rewrite-wikilink  Rewrite all occurrences of a wikilink target across the vault (body + frontmatter)
    validate          Validate vault graph facts and configured frontmatter rules
    completions       Shell completion installation and script emission
    cache             Manage the SQLite-backed vault graph cache
    config            Manage the per-vault `.norn/config.yaml`
    self-update       Update norn to the latest GitHub release
    mcp               Run norn as a Model Context Protocol (MCP) stdio server over the vault at --cwd
    serve             Run the warm host daemon: serves MCP for any vault on this host over a Unix socket
    service           Supervise the warm `norn serve` daemon under launchd (macOS): install/uninstall/start/stop/restart/status
    audit             Read the vault mutation audit trail (the append-only event stream): recent mutations with status / target / trace, filterable
    vault             Manage the vault registry — register a vault to unlock durable artifacts (cache, event stream, logs)

EXAMPLES
    norn find --eq type:note --limit 5
        # 5 notes by default sort

    norn validate --format json
        # machine-readable validation findings

    norn repair --plan --out plan.json
        # generate a MigrationPlan

GLOBAL OPTIONS
    -C, --cwd <CWD>         Run as if norn started in this directory (default: $NORN_ROOT, else the current directory)
        --verbose           Include full diagnostic detail in output
        --no-cache-refresh  Skip the implicit cache refresh before reading the graph
        --color <COLOR>     Color output. Honors NO_COLOR / CLICOLOR_FORCE.
        --vault <NAME>      Target the registered vault with this name (see `norn vault register`)

Documentation: https://github.com/dbtlr/norn
